# APL

![](reference/figures/fig_AP.png)

`APL` is a package developed for computation of Association Plots, a
method for visualization and analysis of single cell transcriptomics
data. The main focus of `APL` is the identification of genes
characteristic for individual clusters of cells from input data.

When working with `APL` package please cite:

    Gralinska, E., Kohl, C., Fadakar, B. S., & Vingron, M. (2022).
    Visualizing Cluster-specific Genes from Single-cell Transcriptomics Data Using Association Plots.
    Journal of Molecular Biology, 434(11), 167525.

## Installation

The `APL` can be installed from GitHub:

``` R
library(devtools)
install_github("VingronLab/APL")
```

To additionally build the package vignette, run instead:

``` R
install_github("VingronLab/APL", build_vignettes = TRUE, dependencies = TRUE)
```

Building the vignette will however take considerable time.

**The vignette can also be found under the link:
<https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/> (hyperlink in the GitHub repository
description).**

To install the `APL` from Bioconductor, run:

``` R
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("APL")
```

## Pytorch installation

In order to speed up the singular value decomposition, we highly
recommend the installation of `pytorch`. Users can instead also opt to
use the slower R native SVD. For this, please set the argument
`python = FALSE` wherever applicable in the package vignette.

### Install pytorch with reticulate

``` R
library(reticulate)
install_miniconda() 
conda_install(envname = "r-reticulate", packages = "numpy")
conda_install(envname = "r-reticulate", packages = "pytorch")
```

### Manually install pytorch with conda

Download the appropriate Miniconda installer for your system from [the
conda website](https://docs.conda.io/en/latest/miniconda.html). Follow
the installation instructions on their website and make sure the R
package `reticulate` is also installed before proceeding. Once
installed, list all available conda environments via  
`conda info --envs`  
One of the environments should have `r-reticulate` in its name.
Depending on where you installed it and your system, the exact path
might be different. Activate the environment and install pytorch into
it.

``` R
conda activate ~/.local/share/r-miniconda/envs/r-reticulate # change path accordingly.
conda install numpy
conda install pytorch
```

## Feature overview

Please run

``` R
vignette("APL")
```

after installation with `build_vignettes = TRUE` for an introduction
into the package.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`apl()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl.md) :
  Association Plot
- [`apl_coords()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl_coords.md)
  : Calculate Association Plot coordinates
- [`apl_ggplot()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl_ggplot.md)
  : Plot Association Plot with ggplot
- [`apl_plotly()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl_plotly.md)
  : Plot Association Plot with plotly
- [`apl_score()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl_score.md)
  : Find rows most highly associated with a condition
- [`apl_topGO()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/apl_topGO.md)
  : Run Gene overrepresentation analysis with topGO
- [`as.cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/as.cacomp.md)
  : Create cacomp object from Seurat/SingleCellExperiment container
- [`as.list(`*`<cacomp>`*`)`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/as.list-cacomp-method.md)
  : Convert cacomp object to list.
- [`ca_3Dplot()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/ca_3Dplot.md)
  : Plot of the first 3D CA projection of the data.
- [`ca_biplot()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/ca_biplot.md)
  : Plot of 2D CA projection of the data.
- [`ca_coords()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/ca_coords.md)
  : Calculate correspondence analysis row and column coordinates.
- [`new_cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/cacomp-class.md)
  : An S4 class that contains all elements needed for CA.
- [`cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/cacomp.md) :
  Correspondance Analysis
- [`cacomp_names()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/cacomp_names.md)
  : Prints slot names of cacomp object
- [`cacomp_slot()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/cacomp_slot.md)
  : Access slots in a cacomp object
- [`calc_residuals()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/calc_residuals.md)
  : Calculate residuals for Correspondence analysis
- [`check_cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/check_cacomp.md)
  : Check if cacomp object was correctly created.
- [`clip_residuals()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/clip_residuals.md)
  : Perform clipping of residuals
- [`comp_NB_residuals()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/comp_NB_residuals.md)
  : Compute Negative-Binomial residuals
- [`comp_ft_residuals()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/comp_ft_residuals.md)
  : Compute Freeman-Tukey residuals
- [`comp_std_residuals()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/comp_std_residuals.md)
  : Compute Standardized Residuals
- [`elbow_method()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/elbow_method.md)
  : Runs elbow method
- [`inertia_rows()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/inertia_rows.md)
  : Find most variable rows
- [`is.empty()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/is.empty.md)
  : Helper function to check if object is empty.
- [`permutation_cutoff()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/permutation_cutoff.md)
  : Calculates permuted association plot coordinates
- [`pick_dims()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/pick_dims.md)
  : Compute statistics to help choose the number of dimensions
- [`plot_enrichment()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/plot_enrichment.md)
  : Generates plot for results from apl_topGO
- [`random_direction_cutoff()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/random_direction_cutoff.md)
  : Random direction association plot coordinates
- [`recompute()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/recompute.md)
  : Recompute missing values of cacomp object.
- [`rm_zeros()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/rm_zeros.md)
  : removes 0-only rows and columns in a matrix.
- [`run_APL()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/runAPL.md)
  [`runAPL()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/runAPL.md) :
  Compute and plot Association Plot
- [`run_cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/run_cacomp.md)
  : Internal function for \`cacomp\`
- [`scree_plot()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/scree_plot.md)
  : Scree Plot
- [`show.cacomp()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/show.cacomp.md)
  [`show(`*`<cacomp>`*`)`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/show.cacomp.md)
  : Prints cacomp object
- [`subset_dims()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/subset_dims.md)
  : Subset dimensions of a caobj
- [`var_rows()`](https://vingronlab.github.io/APL/reference/var_rows.md)
  : Find most variable rows
